$comment: Per-component visual overrides for catalog parts. Read by src/src/richVisuals/meshOverrides.ts
and by the build scripts (measure-mesh-extents, generate-collision-meshes, add-collision-mesh-fields,
component-visual-diagnostics, reshape_bboxes.py, divergence_report.py). Edit here, not in code.
meshOverrides: component id -> source CAD file (kept in assets/step/). The runtime loads the
pre-converted /meshes/glb/<basename>.glb. Parts not listed render through their procedural
proceduralVisualOnly: parts whose authored mesh was rejected, kept for the record; never loaded.
rotationOverrides: Euler XYZ radians applied to the loaded mesh before scaling, mapping the CAD
axes onto the catalog frame (bounding_box_mm / connectors).
scalePolicy: overrides the default per-axis fit of the mesh into the catalog bbox.
shaftOverlays: body-only GLBs get a procedural output shaft (mm) above the scaled body.

mobility_rubber_foot_pad.why: GLB models the full foot + M6 stud (~33x33x50) while the preset is pad-only (25x25x15).

effector_parallel_gripper_small.why: GLB is a flat 11mm plate pair; fitting it into the 65x65x40 bbox rendered a paper-thin 25x4mm gripper. The procedural two-finger generator fills the real envelope.

effector_parallel_gripper_large.why: Same flat plate-pair GLB as the small gripper (100x100x55 bbox).

structural_shaft_collar.why: bbox 18x18x9 vs mesh 60x60x25 (3.37x off): the GLB models a different part.

structural_bracket_l.why: bbox 40mm cube vs mesh 146x72x90 L-bracket (3.65x off).

power_distribution_unit.why: bbox 65x45x15 vs mesh 36x36x4 round PCB (3.66x off).

compute_fpga_dev_board.why: Spec is a small 50x35x10 dev board; the mesh is a 112x87x20 Xilinx-class board (2.47x off).

actuator_linear_small.why: One small linear-servo GLB stretched to 130mm rendered as a thin pole; procedural body + rod instead.

actuator_linear_heavy.why: Same small linear-servo GLB stretched to 350mm.

motor_harmonic_drive_compact.why: The STEP is a disc servo, not a harmonic drive; procedural strain-wave actuator instead. Never converted to GLB.

motor_harmonic_drive_large.why: Same mislabeled STEP as the compact drive.

motor_gear_small_n20.why: Mesh has a right-angle stub instead of an axial D-shaft.

power_supercapacitor_module.why: A single 21mm supercap stretched into a 70mm puck; procedural bank instead.

power_18650_4s2p_pack.why: The 1-cell holder stretched 2x to stand in for an 8-cell pack.

transmission_leadscrew_8mm.why: The "leadscrew" GLB is only the flanged nut; the part is a cut-to-length screw.

sensor_lidar_3d.why: GLB is Y-up (spin axis along GLB Y); Rx(pi/2) stands it upright on the preset +Z.

effector_suction_cup.why: GLB is Y-up; Rx(-pi/2) puts the cup (suction_face) at +Z and the mount at -Z.

structural_servo_coupler_disc.why: Disc thickness is on GLB Y, preset puts it on Z. preset [32,32,8] vs GLB [31.96,8,31.98].

transmission_bearing_deep_groove.why: Bearing axis is on GLB X, preset puts it on Z. preset [22,22,7] vs GLB [7,22,22].

transmission_bearing_large.why: Bearing axis is on GLB X, preset puts it on Z. preset [52,52,15] vs GLB [15,53,53].

compute_sbc_small.why: Board thickness is on GLB Y (20mm), preset puts it on Z (17mm). preset [85,56,17] vs GLB [89,20,58].

compute_motor_driver_dual.why: Board thickness is on GLB Y; without this per-axis scaling renders a wide-but-thin sliver. preset [43,43,15] vs GLB [43,28,43].

mobility_mecanum_wheel.why: Wheel axle is on GLB Y, preset puts it on Z. preset [100,100,48] vs GLB [100,50,110].

sensor_lidar_2d.why: Housing height is on GLB Y, preset puts it on Z. preset [70,70,41] vs GLB [75.64,41.3,75.7].

sensor_depth_camera_small.why: GLB is long on X with the lens on its -Y face; Rz(pi/2) turns the lens to +X (optical_front) and the length onto Y.

sensor_depth_camera_wide.why: Same GLB as the small depth camera.

mobility_caster_wheel.why: Caster mounting plate faces GLB +Y; Rx(pi/2) puts it on top (+Z, mount_top).

structural_standoff_m3.why: Standoff runs along GLB Y; Rx(pi/2) stands it along the preset Z length.

structural_standoff_m4.why: Same GLB as the M3 standoff.

structural_pillow_block_mount.why: KP08 pillow block bore runs along GLB Y; Rz(pi/2) puts it on X (shaft_hole).

motor_worm_gear.why: Output shaft leaves the gearbox along GLB -Y, at right angles to the can; Rx(-pi/2) points it at +Z (shaft_out), can along +Y.

transmission_rigid_shaft_coupling.why: Coupling bore runs along GLB X; Ry(pi/2) puts it on Z (shaft_in/shaft_out).

effector_3finger_adaptive.why: GLB has its bolt-circle mount on +X and fingers reaching -X; Rx(pi/2)*Ry(-pi/2) puts the mount at -Z (mount_back) and aims the fingers at +Z (gripper_open).

power_lipo_3s_2200.why: LiPo GLB (pack with XT60 + balance lead) has its ~103mm length on Z and a ~24x23mm section; Ry(pi/2) maps GLB Z to X (length). Per-axis scale then widens the section to the preset footprint. preset [105,34,24] vs GLB [24,23,103].

power_lipo_6s_10000.why: Same LiPo GLB; preset [165,65,42] (up to 2.7x stretch across the section).

structural_hip_housing_2dof.why: Authored GLB axes already match the preset envelope exactly: preset [66,58,40] vs GLB [66,58,40].

actuator_servo_standard.why: Servo GLBs have the body length on Y; the preset puts it on X with the shaft on +Z. preset [40,20,37] vs GLB [28.5,46.5,41].

actuator_continuous_rotation_servo.why: Same GLB as the standard servo.

actuator_servo_heavy_duty.why: preset [54,42,54] vs GLB [33.5,58.5,54.3]: Rz(pi/2) maps GLB Y to X.

actuator_servo_high_torque.why: Same GLB as heavy_duty; keeps the horn on +Z (shaft_out).

actuator_high_speed_mini_servo.why: preset [32,16,30] vs GLB [29,46.5,38.3]: Rz(pi/2) maps GLB Y to X.

actuator_servo_micro.why: Same GLB as high_speed_mini; keeps the horn on +Z (shaft_out).

motor_dc_medium_540.why: GLB [37,75,37] is long on Y; Rx(-pi/2) maps Y to Z with the shaft end (GLB -Y) at +Z (shaft_out).

motor_dc_small_130.why: GLB [20,38,17] is long on Y with the shaft at -Y; Rx(-pi/2) puts the shaft at +Z (shaft_out).

motor_gear_heavy_50mm.why: GLB [157,45,44] is long on X; Ry(pi/2) maps X to Z.

power_buck_converter_5v.why: GLB [43,14,21] is thinnest on Y; Rx(pi/2) puts the board thickness on Z.

sensor_tof.why: GLB [25,4,11] is thin on Y, preset [12,26,5] thin on Z. Rx(pi/2)*Ry(pi/2) maps GLB X to Y (length), Y to Z (thickness), Z to X (width).

actuator_micro_linear_servo.why: Linear-servo GLB [27,80,15] is long on Y; Rx(pi/2) maps Y to Z (rod axis).

actuator_stepper_nema17.why: GLB [47,72,42] is long on Y; Rx(-pi/2) maps Y to Z with the shaft end (GLB -Y) at +Z (shaft_out).

mobility_mecanum_wheel.why: Rotated GLB [100.2,109.8,50] vs bbox [100,100,48]: uniform 0.952 keeps the rollers round (4.6% gap).

mobility_caster_wheel.why: GLB is a 100mm-tall caster, the preset is the 78mm size; uniform keeps the plate square and the wheel round.

sensor_lidar_2d.why: Rotated GLB [75.6,75.7,41.3] vs bbox [70,70,41]: uniform 0.957 keeps the puck round (3.5% gap).

effector_3finger_adaptive.why: Rotated GLB [130.2,233.3,211.5] matches bbox [131,234,212] to 1%; uniform keeps the finger linkage proportions.

effector_suction_cup.why: Rotated GLB [21.6,21.6,15] vs bbox [23,23,16]: uniform keeps the cup round (6% gap).

actuator_servo_high_torque.why: servo_high_torque.glb is one continuous primitive with no separate shaft; overlay sized to the shaft_out connector diameter. 5mm covers a Dynamixel XM-class horn protrusion.

actuator_servo_heavy_duty.why: Same single-primitive GLB as high_torque; larger shaft_out diameter.
